Didn't understand the loss-offset (הפסד הון מקוזז) paragraph; would drop it
Unclear whether ₪500 monthly can be added to the same deposit as the calculator assumes
Troubled that the site marks the tax treatment of a broken deposit as an open question
No side-by-side comparison of current interest rates across banks

No info on the minimum amount or how to open a deposit
No comparison of a deposit with the S&P 500 for someone their age
No figure for nominal interest earned in shekels before inflation
No info on whether an index-linked deposit would avoid the loss, or what it pays
Would drop the 'מה האתר לקח בחשבון' section
Would drop most of the terms (מונחים) table

problems.why: The reader questions why age matters and is confused by the 12-month example next to a 10-year calculator, but never says the age, linkage or term inputs fail to change the graph.
